name: SafeHaven Store
tagline: An alternative app store focused on open-source, malware-free apps
description:
SafeHaven Store is an open-source alternative to the Google Play Store. It aims to offer verified, open-source apps with built-in malware protection, giving you another way to discover and install apps you can actually trust.

It's an early, community-built project working toward being a safer, more transparent place to get Android apps.
